ascendancies.notes: Necromancer is the only real choice — Mindless Aggression (minion speed + damage), Unnatural Strength (+2 minion gems), Mistress of Sacrifice (offerings affect you), Commander of Darkness (aura effect for minions). Guardian only for support-style tanky variant.

gear_priorities.weapon: +1 minion gems sceptre/wand. Endgame: +2 minion gems (crafted with Bound Fossil or Essence). Budget: vendor recipe for +1 minion gems. Trigger socketed spells craft for auto-curse.
gear_priorities.shield: Rare with life, res, +1 minion gems (shaper mod). Endgame: +2 minion gems shield. Budget: Victario's Charity for frenzy/power charges to minions.
gear_priorities.helmet: Rare with +2/+3 minion gem levels (Elder/Bound Fossil). Life, res. SRS enchant: +2 max SRS spirits. This is a pseudo 7L with Minion Damage + Concentrated Effect built-in.
gear_priorities.body_armour: Rare with life, res. Endgame: skin of the loyal (0-cost, +1 gems), or rare with +1 active gems and life. Budget: Tabula Rasa.
gear_priorities.gloves: Rare with life, res, minion damage (crafted). Gravebind for corpse generation if using Offering loop.
gear_priorities.boots: Rare with life, movespeed, res. Darkness Enthroned belt pairs well (double abyss jewel effect).
gear_priorities.amulet: +1 intelligence gems, +1 fire gems, or +1 all gems. Gem levels are THE scaling stat for SRS. Endgame: Ashes of the Stars.
gear_priorities.rings: Rare with life, res, mana regen (SRS is mana-hungry). Essence Worm if running one big aura.
gear_priorities.belt: Darkness Enthroned — 75% increased effect on 2 abyss jewels with minion damage + life. Otherwise Stygian Vise with life, res.
gear_priorities.flasks: Quicksilver (movespeed), life flask, Rumi's Concoction (block), utility flasks. Minion builds are flask-light.

gem_links.bossing_swap: Swap Melee Splash for Multistrike or Melee Physical Damage. Splash is only for clear.
gem_links.utility: Desecrate + Bone Offering for block. Flesh Offering for minion speed during clear. Convocation to recall minions.
gem_links.movement: Flame Dash + Faster Casting. Shield Charge if using a shield.
gem_links.guard: Molten Shell or Steelskin. Bone Offering with Mistress of Sacrifice gives you block too.

tree_priorities: Minion damage clusters: Redemption, Righteous Army, Sacrifice, Gravepact
Gem level scaling: every +1 gem level is a big damage jump for SRS
Minion life if spirits are dying too fast (rare in softcore)
Aura effect nodes if running Generosity + Hatred
Elemental Overload — SRS has decent base crit, EO is free 40% more
breakpoints: 20 max SRS spirits — achievable with gem level 21 + helmet enchant
Gem level 25+ on SRS — damage scales exponentially with gem levels for minions
Unleash 3 seals — cast 4 SRS at once, much smoother gameplay than manual spam
Block cap (75%) with Bone Offering + Mistress of Sacrifice + tree — makes YOU tanky
Minion accuracy — not usually an issue but check if using Lycosidae or Precision
common_mistakes: Not scaling gem levels — SRS damage scaling is almost entirely from gem levels (+1 gems on weapon, shield, amulet, body). A +5 gem level setup does 3x the damage of a +0 setup.
Forgetting Melee Splash for clear — without it, each spirit hits one mob. Your clear will feel terrible. Swap it out for bosses only.
Not using Convocation — your spirits wander off. Convocation snaps them to you instantly. Put it on left click or a convenient key.
Spamming SRS too fast and going OOM — Unleash solves this. Cast once every 2 seconds for 4 spirits instead of mashing the button.
Neglecting YOUR defenses — you're not a minion. You still take damage. Bone Offering + block + Determination keeps you alive.
Using Hatred without Generosity — Generosity makes Hatred only affect minions, but with 39% more effect. Way better than the base aura.
scaling_tips: SRS is a gem level build. Every +1 to gem level is worth more than almost any other stat. Priority: +1 weapon, +1 shield, +1 amulet, +2 helmet (Elder), Empower Support. After gem levels, minion damage and attack speed are your next scalars. The spirits do fire damage, so Hatred + Generosity converts some phys to cold for a big boost.
